items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Big classical band? Not Arthur Fiedler.

ctx.x: Clothier -- big white band -- I think it was 25 pieces -- with Henry Levine. And what's the fellow now that has the big orchestra, one of them known for classics. It'll come to me. Anyhow, I had my own show with Norman Clothier's band, and, oh, if I could think of that fellow's name because he's so popular now with his big classical band.
Big classical band? Not Arthur Fiedler.

No. It'll come to me before we get through, I think. But now, when I would be -- when I'd sing my jazz part, Norman Clothier and his group would play on this side, and they had a mike set up right, just run right on to the next mike, and Levine would play the sweet stuff for me. See? That's how they arranged it.
